digest.component_or_area: package configuration and optional metrics extra
propositions: Metrics analyzer and lizard dependency must be packaged as optional [metrics] extra in pyproject.toml with guard_import() protecting lazy imports
Core-only install must import rebar and rebar.metrics cleanly without triggering dependency errors, with code_health reporting Unavailable when metrics extra is missing
OptionalDependencyError from guard_import() must be caught by adapters and converted to Unavailable status with reason naming the extra
metrics entry must be registered in src/rebar/_optional.EXTRAS to enable guard_import() and install guidance
import-linter optionality ban-list must remain satisfied: import rebar and import rebar.metrics must stay dependency-free with only internal analyzer.py lazy-importing lizard
